On September 15, 2026, Connect Biopharma Holdings Limited (the “Company”) issued a press release announcing topline results from its global phase 2 study evaluating rademikibart, the Company’s next-generation, potentially best-in-class anti-interleukin-4-receptor alpha antibody as an add-on treatment for acute exacerbations in adult and adolescent participants with asthma and type 2 inflammation (the “Asthma Study”).
On September 15, 2026, the Company announced topline results for the Asthma Study.

Key topline results include: • Rademikibart demonstrated a statistically significant increase from baseline in post-bronchodilator FEV 1 on Day 7 of 250 mL compared to 120 mL with placebo (130mL greater improvement compared to placebo; p=0.023).

The Company expects to report topline data from the ongoing Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (“COPD”) study (CBP-201-207) of rademikibart for the treatment of acute exacerbations in COPD patients with type 2 inflammation later this month and plans to move quickly to meet with the U.S.
